en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small rural railway station building labeled "Lindholmen" beside train tracks. A steam locomotive is partly visible at the left, several people stand on the platform, and to the right is a park‑like area with trees, a bench, and a prominent upright stone monument known as the Gustaf Vasa stone. Printed Swedish text describing the scene appears in the sky area above the station.
